challenge.better_approach: Make the reseal roll back its journal lines on a crash: that writes the door's own record from outside the door and only fixes the crash case. Block the commit when the journal names unstaged records: every shared-tree commit would block on another session's work. Composing the staged journal per path fixes every case at the one place that stages it.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That nothing reads the committed journal expecting lines for uncommitted records (a later commit carries them). Unmeasured; the proof's clause 2 checks the committed journal against the committed tree, and the artifact proofs that run over commits re-green or red.
challenge.prior_art: 23c822fe8095 (path commits; same harness), 30531f6e1c5d (the journal goes with the records), b0e65cf8a77e (reseal crash lands the commit). Grepped tickets, questions and ideas for a journal staged without its records: none.
challenge.real_collision: None. The 2026-09-30 ruling (a reseal crash does not block the commit) still stands.

answers.falsifier: A path commit with another record journaled and unstaged carries HEAD's entry for it; a reseal crashed on ENOSPC leaves a commit whose every journal entry matches its committed blob; the working journal is unchanged by the check.
answers.from_idea: none, because it was measured at a build, not imagined: commit 53c5fbc1c on branch akienasus/c234-fix-forked-journal, ticket c234aae2c0b9
answers.how: check_staged stops staging the whole working journal. It composes the index blob per path: the working entry where the commit's index carries that path's bytes, HEAD's entry otherwise. It writes that blob with hash-object and update-index and leaves the file alone.
answers.traces_to: Law 7: a record of truth (the journal) never says a thing that is not so, and the committed journal said five validations had bytes the commit does not hold. Law 8: a seal line with no seal is a false green a peer leans on.
answers.what: A commit's .artifact-journal.jsonl names only the records that commit carries; a journaled record left unstaged keeps its line in the working tree, not in the commit.

bullets.text: 53c5fbc1c's journal claimed 5 seals the commit did not hold, after the reseal itself said no seal was staged.

title: A commit's .artifact-journal.jsonl names only the records that commit carries; a journaled record left unstaged keeps it
